summary:
Research of w139 (r75, r76) done; notes.md in the run directory has the seven parts.
Both accepted scenarios red today on undefined steps: r75 at Given line 918 (reviewer result 'lists nothing to fix now'), r76 at Given line 926 (analysis session); Then steps after them undefined.
No code calls measure or starts an analysis session; supervise.py run() ends after branch_review; session() starts only agents/<agent>.md; the stand-in refuses an analysis agent (probed).
Probed in scratch repos with the stand-in claude: measure writes the record, refuses a same-day repeat, no log, no spec/index.md; a finished work run leaves the measurement untracked.
Nearest cases: second work run starts no review; a reviewer ending at its turn limit is kept with no result and exits 0 (D1); an initiative whose work-items are all in its base commit gets no review, no log, exit 0 (D2).
Skill analyzing-a-batch step 1 runs measure itself, which a same-day measurement refuses; step 4 commits the report, which work run does not.
Tests-of: no map; all test findings by search. Conditional impact: verified_before_all counts start lines; all-green exit-0 scenarios break if the analysis session is refused.
File set and room under the 300-line limit are in part 7.
